features.name: ISO 5055 Review Standard Integration
features.description: Code review service based on ISO 5055, a language-independent software measurement and review standard with 119 rules for evaluating code quality.
caveats: Not all 119 rules are fully applicable to AL development

features.name: Custom AL Quality Framework
features.description: A proprietary set of custom rules on top of ISO 5055 designed specifically for AL development and quality practices.

features.name: Free Quality Assessment Service
features.description: A free online quality assessment scoring service that runs an analyzer in the background to provide violation counts, findings, and rule evaluation metrics.

features.name: Default Analyzers Configuration
features.description: Standard AppSource analyzers including AppSource Cop, Code Cop, and UI Cop that can be configured in the AL development environment.

features.name: AL Cops and Community Code Cops
features.description: Extended analyzer rules from the lintter cup project providing additional diagnostics including cognitive complexity, parameter validation, and documentation requirements.

features.name: Proprietary Review Analyzer
features.description: A proprietary analyzer tool that generates approximately 500 diagnostics mapped to ISO 5055 and CWE standards, detecting issues like overpermissioned objects and missing read isolation.
caveats: Source code not shared
Some findings may be false positives requiring manual review

features.name: CWE 732 Permission Assignment Mapping
features.description: ISO 5055 rule mapped to CWE 732 that identifies objects declaring more access permissions than required, potentially exposing sensitive data to unauthorized users.
caveats: May require manual review to distinguish between false positives and actual security concerns
Applies primarily to obsolete objects

features.name: Read Isolation and Concurrency Rule EAT-10
features.description: ISO 5055 rule requiring explicit read isolation on record read operations to prevent escalated update locks that cause concurrency degradation under load.
caveats: Rule under review for potential removal
Primary key assumption may not be documented
Some findings may be too strict

features.name: CWE 1083 - Data Access from Outside Data Manager
features.description: Extension code is reading or writing data in ways that bypass the standard BC table access model and circumvent business logic and logging. Intended to ensure data access goes through proper data manager components.
caveats: Diagnostic numbers may differ in official documentation
Mapped from different CWE numbering schemes

features.name: Field Assignment Order Validation
features.description: ISO 5055 diagnostic that validates field assignment order follows standard page-to-table interaction pattern: first run init, then validate primary key fields, call insert true, then validate and modify remaining fields with modify true.
caveats: Flags every field access not in compliant order
Exceptions must be documented

features.name: Primary Key Field Violation Detection
features.description: Detects when primary key fields are set in incorrect order or context, such as before insert operations. The analyzer flags deviations from the standard pattern.
caveats: May produce false positives
Variable scope affects detection

features.name: CWE 778 - Insufficient Logging for Security Events
features.description: Checks whether critical events like permission escalation, bulk data export, and financial posting are captured in telemetry. Requires proper data classification and change log configuration.
caveats: Telemetry rule recently updated
Depends on customer activation of change log
Recommends configuration but not customer behavior

features.name: Isolated Storage Cleanup Validation
features.description: Checks whether isolated storage set operations have corresponding delete procedures in the same scope. Identifies incomplete cleanup of temporary and supporting resources.
caveats: No on uninstall event currently available
Uncertain if uninstall removes isolated storage
Would benefit from additional event coverage

features.name: Isolated Storage Encryption Validation
features.description: Custom rule checking for confirmed encryption on isolated storage operations.
caveats: Custom rule with uncertain applicability
May not be relevant for all scenarios

features.name: CWE 1052 detection
features.description: ISO 10 CWE 1052 detects excessive hard-coded literals in code. Warnings flag instances where values are hard-coded without using labels or constants.
caveats: Requires understanding context to determine if refactoring improves readability

features.name: Magic number detection
features.description: Flags hard-coded numeric values that lack explanation. Recommends extracting them into named variables or functions to improve code readability and maintainability.
caveats: Can produce false positives
Requires judgment on whether refactoring improves readability

features.name: Self-documenting code through extraction
features.description: Demonstrates extracting magic numbers into named functions or variables to make code self-documenting without requiring comments, using example of 24 hours in milliseconds.
caveats: Some magic numbers may not warrant refactoring if it reduces readability
Locked labels discussed as alternative but effectiveness unclear

features.name: CWE 783 mixed boolean operators
features.description: Detects mixed AND and OR operations without explicit parentheses. AL operator precedence differs from C family languages, causing complex boolean expressions to evaluate incorrectly.
caveats: Operator precedence in AL is not clearly documented
Left-to-right evaluation in if statements confirmed but may not be universally known

features.name: Error info pattern
features.description: PAT 03 pattern for raising errors with rich error information. Enables user-actionable fix-it actions and collectible errors, supporting navigate actions to relevant pages.
caveats: Only useful when users can take action to fix the error
Requires platform support for navigate actions

features.name: Error info with custom dimensions
features.description: Error info can attach additional metadata like record IDs and custom dimensions for support troubleshooting. Particularly helpful when support teams need to investigate errors.
caveats: Only beneficial if support team needs to investigate; less useful for user-facing errors

features.name: Error info with navigate actions
features.description: Using error info objects to create error messages with navigate actions that link to relevant pages, allowing users to directly click error messages to fix issues.
caveats: Only works with error info objects
Most beneficial when support needs to fix errors rather than end users

features.name: Unchecked return value detection
features.description: ISO 5055 rule that flags when functions return values but those return values are not checked by the caller, potentially missing error conditions.
caveats: Some cases like codeunit run are intentional and can be marked as accepted
Platform error messages do not provide reasoning or context

features.name: Find set without filters warning
features.description: ISO 5055 rule 1049 that warns when find set is called on complete tables without preceding filters, as this can generate disproportional database load and cause query timeouts.
caveats: Can be marked as intentional for upgrade codeunits that need to process all records
Some cases like extension licenses have few records and may be acceptable

features.name: Delete all without is empty check warning
features.description: Code quality rule that flags delete all operations without first checking whether the filter matches any rows, as deletion without checking can acquire unnecessary locks.
caveats: Requires understanding of AL guidelines documentation
Interaction with update locks and read isolation is complex
False positives can occur with set load fields

features.name: Read isolation and table locking interaction
features.description: Design pattern discussion on how read isolation levels affect table locking when checking is empty before delete all operations, and ensuring consistency between the check and deletion.
caveats: Theoretical race conditions between is empty check and delete all are practically unlikely but theoretically possible
Uncertainty about whether update lock is required for delete operations

features.name: Lock release on variable scope
features.description: Discussion of how update locks set on record variables are released as soon as the variable goes out of scope, affecting the duration of locking.
caveats: Uncertainty about what happens to locks after deletion
Questions remain about lock scope after deletion operations

features.name: Record isolation level on record instances
features.description: Read isolation level specified on a record variable that takes a lock on the last row while subsequent reads will not trigger further locks, limited to the record instance rather than the entire table.
caveats: specifics about lock release behavior when records are deleted not documented
behavior differs from lock table method

features.name: Case statement completeness checking
features.description: ISO 5055 requires all case statements to have an else clause to handle unexpected values and prevent silent failures with unforeseeable outcomes.
caveats: requires defensibility of each branch path

features.name: Explicit HTTP client timeout setting
features.description: HTTP client calls should explicitly set timeout values rather than relying on defaults, making it clear that timeout handling was intentionally considered.
caveats: default timeout exists but explicit setting is better practice

features.name: ISO 5055 code quality assessment
features.description: A code review framework applying ISO 5055 standards to AL code, checking for isolation levels, incomplete case statements, explicit timeouts, and other reliability patterns.
caveats: automatic review may have false positives
living project still being adjusted

features.name: ISO 5055 Quality Scoring System
features.description: An analyzer that assesses code quality against ISO 5055 standards, producing scores around 85-90%, with detection of warnings including missing validate triggers and other reliability issues.
caveats: Proprietary analyzer not published for public use
Produces high noise level of warnings unsuitable for continuous integration

features.name: Quality Assessment Report Service
features.description: A signed quality assessment report that documents code review findings, targeted at management level, designed to confirm code quality for apps and reduce risk documentation for customers and non-developers.
caveats: Report is longer in actual service delivery than the example shown
Requires manual interpretation of findings
